claim: Sample: 98 repositories measured via GitHub star-history endpoint on 2026-10-12; March 2026 was the busiest month in the sample (676,621 stars across the sample).
openai/codex was created 2025-04-13, had its largest day on 2025-04-16 (9,059 stars) and has 128,671 stars as of 2026-10-12.
Gemini CLI was announced 2025-06-25, Apache 2.0, free tier of 60 requests/minute and 1,000/day during preview.
google-gemini/gemini-cli gained 17,854 stars on 2025-06-25 and has 107,286 stars as of 2026-10-12.
anthropics/claude-code has 150,230 stars as of 2026-10-12; its largest day in the window was 2026-03-31 (9,658 stars).
Claude Code's source was exposed through an npm source map on 2026-03-31; Anthropic called it 'a release packaging issue caused by human error'.
Claude Code's LICENSE.md reads 'All rights reserved' under Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service.
sst/opencode redirects to anomalyco/opencode, which has 212,731 stars as of 2026-10-12, 47,528 gained in January 2026.
charmbracelet/crush is licensed under FSL-1.1-MIT.
github/github-mcp-server's busiest 30 days began 2025-04-04 (12,422 stars); 33,523 stars as of 2026-10-12.
ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp was created 2025-09-11 and gained 11,710 stars in the 30 days from 2025-09-23; 53,294 stars as of 2026-10-12.
modelcontextprotocol/servers peaked before April 2025.
Anthropic donated MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation) on 2025-12-09, co-founded with OpenAI and Block; >10,000 active public MCP servers, 97M+ monthly SDK downloads.
modelcontextprotocol/servers is transitioning from MIT to Apache-2.0.
Agent Skills were announced 2025-10-16 and published as an open standard (update dated 2025-12-18).
anthropics/skills was created 2025-09-22 and has 180,509 stars as of 2026-10-12.
anthropics/skills docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx skills are source-available, not open source.
obra/superpowers has 297,708 stars as of 2026-10-12, 66,475 gained in the 30 days from 2026-03-12.
affaan-m/ECC has 277,214 stars as of 2026-10-12, 71,395 gained in March 2026.
GitHub announced Spec Kit on 2025-09-02; github/spec-kit gained 28,578 stars in 30 days from 2025-09-03 and has 140,842 as of 2026-10-12.
OpenClaw was first released 2025-11-24, renamed Moltbot 2026-01-27 and OpenClaw 2026-01-30; creator announced joining OpenAI 2026-02-14.
openclaw/openclaw has 391,696 stars as of 2026-10-12; 25,714 on 2026-01-26; 200,805 in the 30 days from 2026-01-24.

OpenClaw security concerns: Cisco found a third-party skill exfiltrating data (2026-01-28); China restricted state entities (March 2026); review of OpenClaw 2.0 noted secrets unencrypted at rest and sandbox off by default (Aug 2026).
OpenClaw's README lists WhatsApp among its channels.
paperclipai/paperclip was created 2026-03-02, gained 44,210 stars in 30 days from 2026-03-04, has 100,353 stars as of 2026-10-12, MIT.
HKUDS/nanobot was created 2026-02-01 and gained 26,953 stars in its first 30 days.
VoltAgent/awesome-design-md was created 2026-03-31 and gained 67,544 stars in its first 30 days; 120,318 as of 2026-10-12.
cathrynlavery/diagram-design gained 31,696 stars in the 30 days from 2026-08-11; 50,296 as of 2026-10-12.
Leonxlnx/taste-skill's busiest 30 days began 2026-05-25 (30,443 stars).
n8n-io/n8n gained 13,885 stars in April 2025; 207,019 as of 2026-10-12.
n8n: .ee files require an Enterprise License; non-master branches unlicensed (Sustainable Use License).
Dify's modified Apache 2.0 bars multi-tenant operation without written authorisation.
firecrawl/firecrawl is AGPL-3.0, has 190,532 stars and gained 15-17k stars/month June-August 2026.
microsoft/markitdown gained 25,893 stars in April 2026 and 26,146 in June 2026.
thedotmack/claude-mem gained 27,128 stars in the 30 days from 2026-04-10; 99,730 as of 2026-10-12.
volcengine/OpenViking was created 2026-01-05, AGPL-3.0, 39,677 stars as of 2026-10-12.
Octoverse fastest-growing projects by contributors (2025) include cline, vllm, ragflow, sglang and ComfyUI.
openai/gpt-oss gained 6,039 stars on 2025-08-05; Apache-2.0.
karpathy/nanochat gained 7,923 stars on 2025-10-13 and 35,523 in its first 30 days.
Kimi-K2 is under a 'Modified MIT License'.
remotion-dev/skills was created 2026-01-19; remotion gained 11,482 stars in 30 days from 2026-01-20.
Remotion's surge in January 2026 was caused by its agent skills launch.
heygen-com/hyperframes was created 2026-03-10, Apache-2.0, 60,958 stars as of 2026-10-12.
Remotion requires a company licence for for-profit organisations of a certain size.
fish-speech is under the Fish Audio Research License; commercial use requires a separate licence.
aquasecurity/trivy gained 13,879 and google/osv-scanner 4,100 stars in the window.
Shai-Hulud: GitHub notified 2025-09-14, removed 500+ packages; npm plan announced 2025-09-22 (2FA, 7-day granular tokens, trusted publishing).
GitHub restricted stargazer/subscriber listing endpoints to admins and collaborators (changelog 2026-06-30), citing misuse for spam.
Users reported /stargazers 404 from 2026-06-30 and GraphQL restriction from 2026-07-17.
Stargazer listing for openclaw/openclaw returned 404 to an authenticated non-collaborator on 2026-10-12.
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers/history shipped 2026-09-04.
Star history endpoint: per_page max 30, page max 100, weekly buckets with days[7] from Sunday, boundaries not guaranteed UTC.
Star history endpoint returned 200 unauthenticated on 2026-10-12.
Trending lists froze from 2025-11-13; staff acknowledged 2025-12-03 and reported a fix 2025-12-04.
A 2026-04-13 report of unchanged Go/Java trending lists received only a bot reply.
Trending showed 8 daily, 12 weekly, 22 monthly rows at 23:59 UTC on 2026-10-11.
GitHub's 2022 plan to retire Trending was reversed the next day (2022-09-02).
StarScout paper v2 (2025-09-06), 'Six Million (Suspected) Fake Stars'; fake stars surged in 2024 and promote for under two months.
Octoverse 2025 (2025-10-28): 180M+ developers, 36M+ new, TypeScript #1 by contributors in August 2025.
openai/math created 2026-10-06 with 14,066 stars; storytold/photocraft 47,501 stars in 12 days with 9,715 on 2026-10-07.
Octoverse 2026 will publish in late October 2026.
